name: base-lab
description: Base presentation lab (dev scenario baseReview): persistent core at area stage 2 with base turrets on its decks, every outpost form and turrets built on open ground; noon, dusk and night.

warmup.code: const lp = await import('/src/utils/localPreferences.ts'); lp.setStoredPersistentBaseUnlocked(true); lp.setStoredPersistentBaseAreaStage(1); lp.setStoredPersistentBaseAreaStage(2); const r = await dev.run({action:'baseReview', step:'start', time: ck.timeOfDay() ?? 720}); if (!r.ok) throw new Error('baseReview failed: ' + r.error); for (let i = 0; i < 600; i++) { const s = dev.status(); if (s.ready && s.paused) break; await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 100)); }

setup.code: const s = ck.scene; const walk = (list, fn) => { for (const o of list) { fn(o); if (o.list) walk(o.list, fn); } }; const hide = () => walk(s.children.list, o => { const n = (o.constructor && o.constructor.name) || ''; if (/BarSdf|HealthBar/.test(n)) o.setVisible(false); }); hide(); s.events.on('postupdate', hide); s.events.on('prerender', hide); const seen = new Set(); const visit = (o, d) => { if (!o || typeof o !== 'object' || seen.has(o) || d > 4) return null; seen.add(o); if (typeof o.setLight === 'function' && typeof o.releaseLight === 'function' && typeof o.pulse === 'function') return o; for (const k of Object.keys(o)) { let r = null; try { r = visit(o[k], d + 1); } catch (e) {} if (r) return r; } return null; }; const lighting = visit(s, 0); if (!lighting) throw new Error('lighting system not found'); const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(lighting); if (!proto.__fdNoFlashlight) { const orig = proto.setLight; proto.setLight = function (key, preset, ...rest) { if (preset === 'flashlight' || preset === 'flashlightSpill') return; return orig.call(this, key, preset, ...rest); }; proto.__fdNoFlashlight = true; } for (const key of [...lighting.keyed.keys()]) if (key.startsWith('flashlight')) lighting.releaseLight(key, { immediate: true });
